rubric.name: literature-interop plan r3 repair review
criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, the software does not demonstrably do what it claims. Do not manufacture completeness concerns to avoid an empty return -- "no concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.
Check whether the repaired criteria address round 1 without introducing contradictory model roots, artifact bindings, phase dependencies or unsupported inputs. Read 001-panel.md for the dispositions.
Focus on concrete implementation and test blockers in LX2 and LX3 mixed provenance, and LX4 rebinding, lineage date diagnostics and digest continuity. State an observable failure for each concern.
For each retained concern indicate whether it attacks text introduced in the r3 repair or a requirement already present in r2 so the driver can compute the convergence ratio.
